ruling: the directive #1015, queued by the orchestrating session from finding #1002; it applies #963's declared rules to a second leg and settles no new judgement
variants_note: no model and no variant is added: the critical values in force and the draft values of #953 are only read, and the candidates scored are existing ones (spread_mr_ctx of #761, gbm_funding of #634)

series.d_b2_leg: d_t = S(B2) - S(candidate), the lead-averaged grid CRPS of the decision day (scoring_protocol.day_scores), positive favours the candidate: the orientation of the leg against B2 (#913, #929)

series.days: the days of #963's declaration, built by scripts/contiguous_calibration_963.py's `build` unchanged: decision days from 2020-04-03 whose fifth target is on or before 2025-12-31, on the days B1, B2 and both candidates have a forecast; lockbox.require_unlocked on every decision and target day

calibration.rules: scripts/contiguous_calibration_963.py's, unchanged: window_days 125, 250 and 500; the studentized window mean at Newey-West lag 10; generators contiguous (exhaustive, no wrap), stationary_10 and circular_10; 20000 windows and seed 1 for the two random generators; c is the 0.95 quantile of a generator's window statistics
calibration.values_in_force: scoring_protocol.CRITICAL_VALUES, grid comparison: 125 days 3.419438620805254, 250 days 2.425730476113518; 500 days has none and is read at the 250-day value
calibration.values_draft_953: the B2-leg values of draft amendment 3 (PR #953, docs/research/per-leg-calibration-929/result.json, 'B2|post-2020-04'): 125 days 2.682105672772658, 250 days 1.701424623493621; 500 days has none and is read at the 250-day value. The draft is not in force; it is read as a comparison only
calibration.size: the share of a generator's B2-leg window statistics above the value, at the value in force and at the draft value

reading_rules.per_leg: #963's rule, applied to each leg's own contiguous-window c at 250 days: survives below 3.0, fails above 4.0, neither between
reading_rules.joint: 'Supported' needs both legs (scoring protocol item 5), so the joint reading is the worse of the two legs: survives only if both survive, fails if either fails, and neither rule applies otherwise. It is a statement of the two readings together, not a new rule; whether a joint rule should be written is Eleonora's
reading_rules.B1_leg: read from the recomputation, which must equal #963's recorded contiguous c to 1e-9
